name: Acceptance suite-2 test 50b (control) - object action on an object ARN raises no mismatch
note: IAM-1006 (F3) false-positive boundary: s3:GetObject scoped to an OBJECT ARN (arn:aws:s3:::documents/*) is correctly scoped, so there is NO action/resource-type mismatch. A statement that also lists the bucket-only ARN for a sibling bucket action (s3:ListBucket) still must NOT warn, because an object-capable resource is present. Guards against the mismatch warning firing on the routine least-privilege pattern.
